name: Ksenia Se
bio: Co-founder of Turing Post, a newsletter and media platform covering machine learning and AI. She shapes the editorial direction, leads the "Inference" interview series, and produces "Attention Span", a video series explaining major shifts in AI. She has covered machine learning and AI for more than seven years, previously held editor-in-chief roles, and contributed to outlets including Stratfor and Towards Data Science. She is also co-founder of TheSequence.ai, a mother of five, and a frequent speaker and moderator at conferences such as AIE, HumanX, and Ai4.
